common.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded. Please try again.

picker.label: Find a product
picker.placeholder: Type a product name or SKU
picker.hint: Type at least two letters to search.
picker.searchFailed: The search did not work. Please try again.
picker.noVariants: This product has no variant that tracks stock.

stock.title: Stock by branch
stock.subtitle: What is on the shelf in each branch, what is promised to orders and what can still be sold.
stock.levelFor: Set the low-stock level of {sku} in {branch}

adjust.title: Adjust stock

hint.OpeningStock: Use this to enter the first count of a new product. It adds stock.
hint.Correction: Fix a wrong number after checking the shelf. You choose whether to add or remove.
hint.Damage: Units that are damaged and cannot be sold. It removes stock.
hint.Loss: Units that are missing or stolen. It removes stock.
hint.Found: Units that turned up and were not on the books. It adds stock.
hint.CustomerReturn: Units a customer brought back in sellable condition. It adds stock.

adjust.noteHint: Optional. Up to 300 characters, shown in the movement history.

errors.quantityRequired: Enter how many units, 1 or more.
errors.tooMuch: Only {count} can be removed: the rest is reserved for orders.

reorder.title: Low-stock level
reorder.level: Warn me when available stock is at or below
reorder.hint: Enter 0 to switch the warning off.

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.subtitle: Every change of stock, newest first. Entries are never edited or deleted.

transfers.title: Stock transfers
transfers.subtitle: Move stock between branches: request, approve, ship and receive.

newTransfer.title: New transfer
newTransfer.subtitle: Ask for stock to move from one branch to another.
newTransfer.branchesHint: Either side can ask. The sending branch approves and ships; the receiving branch confirms the arrival.
newTransfer.linesHint: Find a product, add its variants and set the quantities.
newTransfer.needTwoBranches: You can only choose between the branches you work in. You need at least two to start a transfer here.

errors.quantity: Every item needs a quantity of 1 or more.

timeline.shipped: Shipped: stock left the sending branch
timeline.received: Received: stock entered the receiving branch

done.ship: Transfer shipped. The stock has left the sending branch.
done.receive: Transfer received. The stock is now in the receiving branch.

ship.title: Ship this transfer?
ship.description: The items are taken out of the stock of {from} now. Check that the goods are really leaving.

reject.title: Reject this request?
reject.description: Nothing moves and the request is closed.

cancel.title: Cancel this transfer?
cancel.description: The transfer is closed and nothing moves.
cancel.descriptionInTransit: The goods are on their way. Cancelling puts them back into the stock of {from}.

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.subtitle: Count what is really on the shelf, review the differences and correct the numbers.

start.title: Start a stock count
start.description: The system quantities are saved now. Staff then enter what they counted.
start.noteHint: Optional, for example the shelf or the reason for the count.
start.scopeAll: Every variant that has stock in this branch.
start.scopeSome: {count, plural, one {Only # chosen variant.} other {Only # chosen variants.}}

countDetail.reviewHint: This count is waiting for review. Approving it books the differences as stock movements.
countDetail.approvedHint: Approved on {date}. The differences are in the stock history.
countDetail.editHint: Type what you counted. Leave a line empty to skip it: skipped lines change nothing.
countDetail.noDifferences: No line differs from the system.

done.approve: Count approved. The differences are booked.
done.reopen: Count sent back for more counting.

approve.title: Approve this count?
approve.description: {lines, plural, one {# line differs} other {# lines differ}} from the system (net {net}). The stock numbers will be corrected and recorded in the history.

cancel.title: Cancel this count?
cancel.description: The count is closed and no stock is changed.
